description: Get a GATE Daily practice set for the user to solve: ten original GATE CS & IT questions in the exam's format (MCQ, MSQ, NAT; 1 and 2 marks; GATE negative marking), published every day at 00:00 IST. Returns the questions without answers. Use it when the user wants to practise for GATE CS, solve questions, or keep a daily study habit. The user solves them; don't solve them for the user. Leave out date for the newest set.

date.description: A past set's date, YYYY-MM-DD (IST). Leave out for the newest set.

name: get_daily_set

text.description: the question in markdown (LaTeX between $ signs), without its answer

timeSec.description: about how long the question should take, in seconds

subject.description: subject code of a subject set; null for the daily set

today.description: the set's date is today in IST

title: Get the GATE Daily set
